state.instructions: Review the exact old/new operation authorities below.
state.facts: Reception is required to book walk-ins within granted locations, without granting invoice credit. Present bookings use actor for their owner, preventing actual customer self-service on staff bookings. Existing manager and company/individual booker branches are preserved. Actor identity stays the staff principal in receipts and history. The added optional account is permitted only to reception plus can_work, and typed-reference validation remains; no check currently proves the selected account belongs to this customer.
state.current_code:
scenario hold(resource:Resource,customer:Customer,from:datetime label=label_RoomRequest_from,until:datetime label=label_RoomRequest_until,quantity:int,email:email,attendees:int=1 label="Attendees"@{nl="Deelnemers"},use_allowance:bool=false label=label_hold_use_allowance) by=authenticated label="Hold workspace"@{nl="Werkplek tijdelijk reserveren"}
   require actor.email_verified and customer.active and resource.location in customer.locations
   require (reservation_manager and can_work(actor,resource.location)) or (customer.kind==individual and owns(actor,customer)) or has_location_role(actor,customer,booker,resource.location) or has_location_role(actor,customer,administrator,resource.location)
   require resource.price_unit==hour and attendees>0 and attendees<=resource.party_limit and from>=now and from<until and quantity>0 and until-from>=resource.minimum and (until-from)%resource.increment==0m
   require free(resource,from-resource.buffer_before,until+resource.buffer_after,quantity,null)
state.proposed_code: scenario hold(...,account:user?=null) by=authenticated or reception; require actor.email_verified and customer.active and resource.location in customer.locations; require account==null or (reception and can_work(actor,resource.location)); require (reception and can_work(actor,resource.location)) or (reservation_manager and can_work(actor,resource.location)) or (customer.kind==individual and owns(actor,customer)) or has_location_role(actor,customer,booker,resource.location) or has_location_role(actor,customer,administrator,resource.location); create Booking {account=account ?? actor}; prepare by=authenticated or reception; require (booking.account==actor or (reception and can_work(actor,booking.parent.location))) and booking.status==held and booking.billing_delivery==null and now<booking.expires; actor remains true admitting account in receipt/history.
